metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly apparel accessories in bulk. Perfect for uniforms and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly blends combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester, making them ideal for apparel accessories that see frequent use and washing. Whether you need custom bandanas for a safety crew or branded headwear for a company picnic, this fabric holds color well through screen printing and embroidery. It resists shrinking and fading better than 100% cotton, so your logo stays sharp event after event.
